name: Simple Electric Circuit
semanticDescription: Complete laboratory electric circuit trainer board (NCERT Class 10 Science Fig 12.1) comprising dual-cell DC power supply (3.0V), plug key switch, DC moving-coil ammeter (0-3A), incandescent light bulb in socket with glowing tungsten filament, and fixed resistor connected in series by insulated leads.
simplifications: Arranged on modular laboratory educational demonstration board.
Wire routing follows standard textbook schematic topological layout.

materials.look: Dark slate Bakelite trainer mounting plinth
Machined solid brass contact blocks, binding nuts, and plug key
Calibrated 0-3A ivory meter dial with deflected red needle
Flexible red positive connecting leads with spade lugs
